newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-HINGIS QUALIFIES FOR FOURTH FINAL IN A ROW.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HINGIS QUALIFIES FOR FOURTH FINAL IN A ROW.

text.p: Swiss prodigy Martina Hingis extended her unbeaten run to 18 matches when she overwhelmed Iva Majoli of Croatia 6-1 6-3 to qualify for her fourth final in succession in the Paris Open on Saturday.
Top seed Hingis, winner of the Australian Open, will face Anke Huber in Sunday's final. The German third seed beat Czech second seed Jana Novotna 6-3 6-4 in the other semifinal.
Hingis took only 52 minutes to crush Majoli, once regarded as a potential successor to former world number one Monica Seles.
"Everything is easy at the moment", Hingis said, smiling. "I go out there. I have fun and I love it. That's my job. When I don't play for two or three days I start boring myself.
"I have won all the tournaments and all my matches so far but that does not mean I can win everything. I play one match after the other and we will see."
Hingis and Huber have met five times and the German has won only once.
